'''Crown Island''' is a small island to the north of [[Shank's Reef]] in [[Lapidis Isle]]. It is inhabited by [[Wallowfin tribe|Wallowfin]] murlocs who have built camps along the shore.

[[Wally Burnside]] can be found here, stranded after the sinking of the ''[[Tidemaster]]'' in Shank's Reef.
